gov_aud_f1.design: Two-part defense. (1) classify_field is total and fail-closed: broad governance substring net over the FULL dotted path first, tight exact-name inert allowlist over the leaf second, everything else UNKNOWN and REJECTED. (2) Governance fields compared as a path-independent aggregate mapping each field name to the sorted MULTISET of its values, so byte-identical relocation passes while semantic drift fails regardless of which file carries it.

self_found_defect.found_by: own adversarial probing during the PAL codereview workflow
self_found_defect.defect: ProofOnlyBundle.aggregate_fields synthesised a disambiguation key f'{field_name}#{document}' that shared a namespace with real field names and was therefore FORGEABLE.
self_found_defect.exploit: audited {A:{known_risks:[R1]}, B:{known_risks:[R2]}} vs successor {A:{known_risks:[R1], 'known_risks#B':[R2]}, B:{known_risks:[R1]}} produced an identical aggregate and returned PASS, while document B had silently DROPPED risk R2 — reopening the exact F1 laundering channel.
self_found_defect.fix: Replaced the synthesised namespace with a per-field sorted multiset of values. A dropped value changes the multiset and no crafted field name can restore it.
self_found_defect.status: FIXED AND VERIFIED before content freeze
